Message.Name: Timestamp Seconds Message
Message.Description: For every second during which there is at least one payload message, the seconds since the Unix epoch.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: The UTC time, giving the number of seconds since the Unix epoch (midnight, January 1, 1970).

Message.Name: System Event Message
